WITH station_phase AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bandusage
  FROM observatories AS o
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
), phase_summary AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(station_avg_bandusage) AS avg_bandusage,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_phase
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  avg_bandusage,
  station_count,
  CAST(station_count AS REAL) / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction
FROM phase_summary;

assumptions.assumption: Count stations with a matching telescope; observatories without a matching telescope are excluded along with unmatched telescopes.
